detail.name: Porcelume Plate Ornament · Secluded Valley Orchid
detail.desc: A Porcelume plate crafted from Lumite ore, slow-fired to perfection — a Buyan-certified cultural specialty of the Waifei Peninsula. It's meant for display only, but any sweets set on it somehow pick up a faint whiff of orchid.
